prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return image 1 as ONE wide, transparent-background isometric treasury prop for Dungeon Empire. Make a localized art correction to the TWO chests and FIVE sacks ONLY, using images 2–5 as their actual art bible. The first image is the edit canvas and definitive layout. Match its exact canvas aspect, framing, relative object footprints, isometric angles, object counts, occlusion order, size of each object, foreground transparent wedge, contact shadows, and particularly its wonderful VOLUMINOUS GOLD PILE and scattered coins. Retain that original mass, hue, coin sizes, heights and silhouette. The whole grouping must remain a single sprite with all negative space genuinely transparent, full margins on all sides; no floor, walls, scenery, glow cast into alpha, torches, text, outline around the group or separate atlas pieces.

Left of center, repaint the already open chest with the identity of image 2 and at the size and position of the existing open chest in image 1. Dark plum WOOD PANELS, large blue-black forged iron bands with pale blue-grey crisp bevels, heavy chamfered corner feet and a distinctive chevron-ended central metal strap on the raised arched lid. The lid is genuinely open and the gold inside is visible. Exactly one readable violet lozenge KEYHOLE on its front (no second lock on the lid). Right of center, make the CLOSED chest the same design in the orientation of image 3, recessed violet lock, dark plum wood, silhouette of its horn-like iron corner caps, same lighting/materials. Keep singular dark-metal outlines and cool stone-colored highlights on both. No ordinary brown plank/riveted pirate chests. Don't enlarge the chests: the gold mound stays the focal mass.

Repaint all five existing sacks IN PLACE and preserve their distinct silhouettes: the tied sack at left and the two tied at back/right are like image 4; the open bags at front left and front right show gold and follow image 5. Slouched oxblood/burgundy leather with deep cool plum folds and a few chunky warm stitches, dark cord, steel tips, small violet seal on tied bags. Vary folds, knot direction and tilt slightly. These are soft money pouches, not rigid pots. At 372 screen pixels for the entire sprite, their dark contours and one broad ridge of rim light should read clearly. The bags should remain red-brown leather, not neon-purple collectibles. Balance the material contrast: warmer gold, subtle purple confined to hardware and cords, cool blue iron. One coherent painting under the same upper-left light and fixed 2:1 isometric camera. No changes to the room or any background, which is completely transparent.
